engineeringPrinciples.acousticRadiationForce: Acoustic standing waves set up spatial gradients in acoustic energy density, imparting a non-zero time-averaged acoustic radiation force (F_rad = -∇⟨U⟩) that drives dispersed crystal nuclei toward nodal or antinodal pressure planes depending on the acoustic contrast factor Φ.
engineeringPrinciples.rayleighEckartStreaming: Viscous dissipation in the fluid boundary layer generates secondary acoustic streaming vortices (Eckart bulk streaming and Rayleigh micro-streaming), creating localized shear rates γ_dot > 12,000 s⁻¹ without bulk turbulent heating or cavitation erosion.
engineeringPrinciples.shearInducedNucleation: The acoustic micro-shear decreases the thermodynamic free energy barrier of nucleation (ΔG*), accelerating the primary nucleation rate J by orders of magnitude and favoring the high-density formation of thermodynamically preferred Form V or β' polymorphic seeds.
engineeringPrinciples.nonThermalPreservation: Because the megasonic MHz regime minimizes violent bubble collapse (unlike 20–40 kHz power ultrasound), there is zero acoustic cavitation erosion of titanium acoustic windows and negligible chemical sonolysis (no free radical generation or lipid peroxidation).

regulatoryStandards.scope: Mandates sanitary tri-clamp or aseptic aseptic fittings for temperature probes, acoustic sensors, and pressure transmitters.

regulatoryStandards.title: European Hygienic Engineering & Design Group Guidelines for Closed In-Line Equipment
regulatoryStandards.scope: Requires validation of in-line cleanability and steam sterilizability (SIP) without dismantling, guaranteeing zero microbial entrapment in acoustic nodal crevices.
